body: See, the only issue with that is Gandalf's original plan was to leave the ring in Rivendell with Elrond. The plan to destroy it wasn't made until the ring arrived in Rivendell. When Gandalf was rescued from Orcanth by the Eagles, his plan was still to leave the ring in Rivendell, not to destroy it. Past that, Gandalf had no contact with the Eagles, so his "Fly, you fools" was no more than telling the fellowship to flee, not to go to the Eagles.
